features.description: WHEN the default preset is configured and built THEN it succeeds as C++23 with no compiler warnings
WHEN ctest runs THEN all unit tests of Coord, Position, Rules, Limits and SearchEvent pass
WHEN the dependency check runs THEN pygomo_core includes no process, stream, thread or protocol-name header and the command exits 0
WHEN the smoke command documented in CLAUDE.md runs THEN it passes
steps: run the Smoke command from CLAUDE.md

last" (no final newline) THEN the listener receives "a", "b", "", "last" in order and then exactly one onClosed(Eof)

features.description: WHEN close() is called THEN later writeLine returns a Closed error and the listener receives exactly one onClosed(Requested)
WHEN a line is longer than maxLineLength THEN the listener receives onClosed(LineTooLong) and no later line
WHEN the dependency check runs THEN pygomo_core is still clean and the transport port headers contain no protocol or engine name, exit 0
WHEN the line is "ERROR <text>" THEN the result is ErrorEvent with that text, and plain MESSAGE/DEBUG lines come back as UnparsedEvent holding the original line
WHEN the line is "x,y" THEN the result is BestMoveEvent with 0-based coords, "SWAP" gives SwapEvent, and malformed or out-of-range coordinates give UnparsedEvent
WHEN a UCI-like MESSAGE line carries depth, ev, n, tm and pv (also partial or truncated) THEN InfoEvent holds exactly the fields present and nothing throws
WHEN a line is not recognised THEN the result is UnparsedEvent with the original text and the parser never throws
WHEN the whole suite and the dependency check run THEN every test passes, pygomo_core is untouched and still clean, exit 0
WHEN a test EventSink is fed each SearchEvent type THEN it receives them in order
WHEN a fake adapter implements EnginePort (startSearch, stop, sendRaw, setRules returning Unsupported, supports) in a core-only target THEN it compiles and behaves as driven
WHEN a fake engine emits info events then a best move THEN the blocking search() returns the best move and the collected info, also when the fake emits from another thread
WHEN the dependency check runs THEN pygomo_core is still clean (the blocking helper lives outside core) and exit 0
WHEN startSearch runs on a 15x15 position with 3 moves THEN the transport receives START 15, INFO rule, the limit INFOs that are set, BOARD, the three stones with owner flags, DONE, in that order
WHEN rules are {Renju, FreeOpen} THEN INFO rule 4 is sent; WHEN rules are {Standard, Swap1} THEN setRules returns Unsupported and nothing is written

WHEN the engine prints info lines then 7,7 THEN the sink gets info events then a best move and the search ends; SWAP gives a swap event; a best move outside the board or on a stone gives an error event
WHEN stop() is called mid-search THEN YXSTOP is sent and the best move the engine then prints is still delivered as the terminal event
WHEN the transport closes mid-search THEN the sink gets exactly one error event, blocking search() returns without hanging, and a later startSearch returns NotReady
WHEN the position is not square THEN startSearch returns Unsupported and writes nothing (the Gomocup RECTSTART path is not supported by the reference engine)

WHEN the child prints "a
b

last" (no final newline) and exits THEN the listener gets a, b, an empty line and last, then exactly one onClosed(Eof)
WHEN cat is the child and 8 threads each write 100 lines THEN 800 complete lines come back and none interleaves
WHEN close() is called while the child blocks (sleep 60) THEN onClosed(Requested) arrives within 3 seconds, the child is gone and reaped, and later writes return Closed
WHEN the child exits by itself with code 3 THEN onClosed(Eof) arrives and exitStatus() reports 3
WHEN the executable does not exist THEN start() returns an error, no thread is left running and the listener is never called
WHEN the child prints a line longer than maxLineLength THEN the listener gets onClosed(LineTooLong) and the child is terminated
WHEN the process tests run 20 times under the tsan preset THEN they all pass with no ThreadSanitizer warning
steps: cmake --preset tsan && cmake --build --preset tsan && ctest --preset tsan --repeat until-fail:20 -R proc_
features.checked_by: cmake --preset tsan && cmake --build --preset tsan && ctest --preset tsan --repeat until-fail:20 -R proc_

features.description: WHEN the dependency check runs THEN pygomo_core is untouched and clean, and POSIX headers appear only in pygomo_process, exit 0

WHEN the parser reads every line of each real Rapfi transcript in tests/fixtures/gomocup/ THEN no line is lost (every unrecognised line is kept as Unparsed with its text) and each fixture records engine version, command and config

WHEN a line is a Rapfi Speed|Depth|Eval|Node|Time summary, a per-depth line (also with the [Pondering] prefix), a Bestline, a multipv line or an MCTS Speed|Visit|Time line THEN the parser returns an InfoEvent with the fields present (rounded K/M/G and time units as printed) and the existing UCI-like parsing is unchanged

WHEN PYGOMO_RAPFI points at the engine THEN search() through GomocupEngine and ProcessTransport returns a legal move on a 15x15 board with 3 moves and at least one info event; WHEN it is unset THEN the test is skipped
WHEN stop() is called during an unlimited Rapfi search THEN a move is still delivered and the search ends within a few seconds (one retry allowed for the documented stop race)
WHEN the transport is closed during a Rapfi search THEN the sink gets exactly one error event and no Rapfi process is left
WHEN the whole suite and the dependency check run without PYGOMO_RAPFI THEN everything passes and exit is 0

WHEN "=12 hello", "?7 bad move", "= " and "=" are parsed as response headers THEN each gives the right ok flag, id (12, 7, none, none) and body ("hello", "bad move", "", ""), and a line starting with neither = nor ? gives no header

WHEN D4, j10, AA3, pass, resign and I5 are parsed on 15x15 and 19x19 boards THEN A1 is the bottom-left point, I is rejected, pass and resign are their own values, out-of-board points are rejected, and format(parse(v)) == v for every point of both boards

WHEN the source-derived kata-analyze and lz-analyze fixture lines are parsed THEN the first info entry gives an InfoEvent with visits as nodes and the PV as 0-based Coords, and a line that is not an info line or has a bad PV vertex gives an UnparsedEvent holding the line
WHEN empty, garbage, very long and out-of-range inputs are given to the three parsers THEN none throws and none reads out of bounds (also under the sanitizer run)
WHEN the whole suite and the dependency check run THEN everything passes and scripts/check-core-deps.sh exits 0

WHEN startSearch runs on a 15x15 position with 2 moves THEN the lines written are, in order, boardsize 15 15, clear_board, the rule command, play B H8, play W G7, genmove B, each with an increasing id

WHEN the fake engine replies =N H8, = pass, = resign or ?N illegal move THEN the sink gets exactly one terminal event (BestMoveEvent, PassEvent, ErrorEvent, ErrorEvent holding the engine text), and a move on an occupied point gives an ErrorEvent
WHEN setRules or startSearch is given Swap1, matchTime or maxDepth THEN it returns Unsupported and writes nothing; supported rules and limits give the expected commands; a 20x10 board works

WHEN startSearch is called twice, or the transport closes mid-search, or stop() is called THEN the second call returns Busy, the close gives exactly one ErrorEvent, and stop() writes nothing while the search still finishes
WHEN the whole suite, the tsan preset and scripts/check-core-deps.sh run THEN all pass (no live test, no claim of working with a real engine)

WHEN startSearch runs with a rule, maxMoves and all four limits set THEN the lines written are INFO rule N, INFO max_moves N, INFO timeout_turn MS, INFO timeout_match MS, INFO max_depth N, INFO max_node N (INFO upper case, keys lower case) while START, BOARD and DONE stay upper case
WHEN the gomo2_* live tests run with PYGOMO_RAPFI set THEN search, stop and close still pass with the lower-case keys
WHEN the whole suite, the tsan preset and scripts/check-core-deps.sh run THEN all pass

WHEN startSearch runs on a 15x15 position with 3 moves THEN the transport receives START 15, the rule command, BOARD, the three stones as plain x,y in play order, DONE; an empty board sends BOARD then DONE
WHEN rules are {Renju, FreeOpen, maxMoves 200} THEN RENJU and maxmoves 200 are sent after START; WHEN the opening is Swap1 or Swap2 THEN setRules returns Unsupported and nothing is written
WHEN turnTime and maxNodes are set THEN INFO timeout_turn MS and kata-set-param maxVisits N are sent; WHEN maxDepth or matchTime is set THEN startSearch returns Unsupported and nothing is written
WHEN the engine replies OK, MESSAGE lines, x,y, or ERROR THEN OK is dropped, MESSAGE becomes UnparsedEvent, x,y the best move and ERROR ends the search
WHEN the whole suite, the tsan preset and scripts/check-core-deps.sh run THEN all pass
WHEN setAnalyze is set THEN startSearch sends kata-genmove_analyze <color> interval <cs> as the last command, with the same setup commands before it; WHEN it is not set THEN genmove is sent as before
WHEN info lines arrive in the open reply of an analyze search THEN each becomes an InfoEvent at once; WHEN the play X line and the blank line arrive THEN one BestMoveEvent ends the search
WHEN the analyze reply is ?, lacks a final play, or the connection closes mid-stream THEN exactly one ErrorEvent ends the search
WHEN the gtp2_* tests run THEN they pass unchanged, and stop() is still a no-op
WHEN the whole suite, the tsan preset and scripts/check-core-deps.sh run THEN all pass

WHEN parseGomocupLine gets `MESSAGE <text>` that is not an info shape THEN it returns MessageEvent{text} with the text after `MESSAGE ` kept raw; OK, ERRORS, DEBUG, an empty line and malformed coordinates stay UnparsedEvent

WHEN GomocupEngine or KataGomoEngine receives a MessageEvent during a search THEN it reaches the sink as a non-terminal event and the search still ends with BestMove or Error; blocking search collects it in `other`
WHEN the whole suite, the tsan preset and scripts/check-core-deps.sh run THEN all pass

WHEN GtpEngine gets `= <id> resign` for genmove (also as the final `play resign` of kata-genmove_analyze) THEN the sink receives exactly one ResignEvent and no ErrorEvent; pass, error replies and bad moves behave as before
WHEN the port contract is read THEN ResignEvent is a SearchEvent alternative listed as terminal in engine_port.hpp, and blocking search treats it as terminal
WHEN the whole suite, the tsan preset and scripts/check-core-deps.sh run THEN all pass
WHEN harness.json lists a profile name not matching /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/ (e.g. ../x, A, a/b) THEN loadProfileChecks imports nothing for it and harness-check reports an error finding
WHEN a profile directory resolves (also through a symlink) outside profile-checks/ or ../profiles/ THEN it is skipped
WHEN an edit targets harness.json, .claude/** or docs/** (other than the exempt files) THEN the gate answers permissionDecision ask with a reason
WHEN the target is docs/handoff.md, docs/todo/**, docs/fix-log.md or docs/notes/** THEN the gate does not ask
WHEN the path to features.json goes through a symlink, .. or differs in case on a case-insensitive filesystem THEN the gate still recognises it and asks
WHEN an Edit/MultiEdit is applied to the current features.json and the resulting JSON differs only in passes THEN the gate allows it, otherwise it asks, even if whitespace or formatting changed
WHEN tool_name is not Edit, MultiEdit or Write THEN the gate asks instead of allowing
WHEN the child is `sh -c 'sleep 60 & wait'` and close() is called THEN the grandchild `sleep` is also gone (not running) within 3 seconds
WHEN the child closes its stdin and writeLine hits EPIPE THEN it returns IoError and the test process is not killed by SIGPIPE
WHEN a ProcessTransport has been started and closed THEN the process-wide SIGPIPE disposition is the same as before
WHEN the whole suite, the tsan preset and scripts/check-core-deps.sh run THEN all pass
